name.zh: 博尔努 · 卡内米宫廷区域核心

properties.sourceTreatment: dark-grey core traced from raster; retained source graticule approximately aligned
properties.attribution: Vincent Hiribarren; adapted by World History Atlas from the Borno territorial evolution map.

note.en: 1890 source depiction of the dark Borno core, shown for 1886–1892 as regional context. The historian describes these maps as approximate reconstructions of European geographical views, not surveyed borders. The shaded core omits surrounding districts and does not trace Rabih’s military frontier. Rabih’s conquest is dated to 1893–1894 in the cited scholarship. Colonial treaty claims and actual local rule differed; an annual colonial unit can overlap this reference.
note.zh: 以1890年原图的深色博尔努核心区，作为1886—1892年的区域参照。作者说明这些地图是对欧洲地理观念的近似重建，并非实测边界。深色核心区不包括周围地区，也不描绘拉比赫的军事疆界。所引研究将拉比赫的征服记为1893—1894年。殖民条约主张与地方实际统治并不相同，年度殖民单元可能与此参照重叠。

name.en: Borno region · warfare and disputed succession
name.zh: 博尔努地区 · 战争与继承争夺

properties.sourceTreatment: dark-grey core traced from raster; retained source graticule approximately aligned
properties.attribution: Vincent Hiribarren; adapted by World History Atlas from the Borno territorial evolution map.

note.en: 1898 source depiction of the dark Borno core, shown for 1900–1901 as regional context. The historian describes these maps as approximate reconstructions of European geographical views, not surveyed borders. The shaded core omits surrounding districts and does not trace Rabih’s military frontier. Rabih’s conquest is dated to 1893–1894 in the cited scholarship. Colonial treaty claims and actual local rule differed; an annual colonial unit can overlap this reference. After Rabih’s death, his son and returning Kanemi claimants competed amid French and British intervention; British and German occupations followed by 1902. The article gives conflicting 1900/1901 dates for the battle, so no exact death year is asserted here.
note.zh: 以1898年原图的深色博尔努核心区，作为1900—1901年的区域参照。作者说明这些地图是对欧洲地理观念的近似重建，并非实测边界。深色核心区不包括周围地区，也不描绘拉比赫的军事疆界。所引研究将拉比赫的征服记为1893—1894年。殖民条约主张与地方实际统治并不相同，年度殖民单元可能与此参照重叠。 拉比赫身亡后，其子与返回的卡内米家族争夺权力，法国和英国亦介入；英德占领到1902年形成。文章对战役写有1900和1901两种年代，此处不断言确切死亡年份。
